name: Soria (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of the city of Soria (a castle on red within a bordure inscribed SORIA PURA CABEZA DE ESTREMADURA).
history: The flag of the municipality is rectangular, of proportions 1:2, white with the arms of Soria at the centre; the motto on the arms is Soria pura, cabeza de Estremadura.
